expectations.text: Pushes back on the 'are you sure?' modal as the primary fix
expectations.evidence: "Not really — an 'are you sure?' modal is the weakest device on the ladder for this problem"

expectations.text: Explains habituation or click-through blindness as why frequent dialogs stop working
expectations.evidence: "People who habitually click through dialogs (which is most people, most of the time) will click through this one too."

expectations.text: Recommends reversibility (soft delete with a retention window) as the strongest option
expectations.evidence: "Soft-delete with a grace period (strongest fix) — deleting marks the workspace for purge in ~30 days"

expectations.text: Recommends grace-period undo as a strong low-friction option
expectations.evidence: "Grace-period undo toast — 'Workspace deleted. Undo' for ~10 seconds, no friction on the happy path."

expectations.text: Recommends type-the-workspace-name confirmation for the irreversible case
If a dialog is retained, requires it to name the workspace and the scale of what is lost
expectations.evidence: Mentions type-to-confirm but does not specify what a retained dialog should display about workspace name or loss scale

expectations.text: Notes that the server must enforce the deletion rules, not just the UI
expectations.evidence: Discusses backend changes needed but does not explicitly note server-side enforcement requirement

expectations.text: Gives an explicit preference order rather than an undifferentiated list of ideas
expectations.evidence: "1. Soft-delete with a grace period (strongest fix)" with numbered ranking
